title: packs.toml
description: Texture packing config for `pano`, read from `packs.toml` in the current directory or from the path given to `--config`. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory and may not climb above it. Every libGDX TexturePacker setting may be set here at the root, on an atlas, or on a single variant; each key resolves variant → atlas → root → default independently. Unknown keys are ignored, matching the loader. See src/config.gleam for the loader.

jar.description: Path to the libGDX runnable TexturePacker jar. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory.

concurrency.description: Number of pack jobs (one atlas at one variant's scale) to run concurrently. Values below 1 are clamped to 1.

atlases.description: The atlas registry, keyed by atlas name. Must have at least one entry.

pot.description: Pad output pages to power-of-two dimensions.

multiple_of_four.description: Pad output pages to dimensions that are a multiple of four, as some compressed texture formats require.

min_width.description: Minimum width of a packed page, in pixels.

min_height.description: Minimum height of a packed page, in pixels.

square.description: Force every packed page to have the same width and height.

wrap_x.description: Horizontal texture wrap mode written to the atlas. Forwarded verbatim, not validated.

wrap_y.description: Vertical texture wrap mode written to the atlas. Forwarded verbatim, not validated.

alias.description: Pack pixel-identical images only once and point every duplicate region at the same pixels. Turn off to keep one region per source image.

ignore_blank_images.description: Skip fully transparent source images instead of adding an empty region for them.

fast.description: Pack much faster at the cost of less efficient page layouts.

debug.description: Draw the bounds of every packed image onto the output pages.

silent.description: Suppress the packer's own progress output.

premultiply_alpha.description: Multiply RGB by alpha in the output pages (premultiplied alpha).

bleed_iterations.description: Number of bleed passes when `bleed` is on. Raise to 4 or 8 if downscaled sprites show dark fringes.

limit_memory.description: Hold only one source image in memory at a time, reading each image twice. Off keeps every image in memory and reads each once.

grid.description: Place images in a uniform grid, in order, instead of bin packing.

padding_x.description: Horizontal padding between packed images, in pixels.

padding_y.description: Vertical padding between packed images, in pixels.

edge_padding.description: Apply padding to the edges of the packed page.

duplicate_padding.description: Fill padding by duplicating the edge pixels of each image.

rotation.description: Allow rotating images 90 degrees to improve packing.

strip_whitespace_x.description: Strip transparent horizontal whitespace from source images before packing.

strip_whitespace_y.description: Strip transparent vertical whitespace from source images before packing.

alpha_threshold.description: Alpha value below which a pixel is considered transparent for whitespace stripping.

filter_min.description: Minification texture filter, e.g. `Nearest`, `Linear`, `MipMapLinearLinear`. Forwarded verbatim, not validated.

filter_mag.description: Magnification texture filter, e.g. `Nearest`, `Linear`. Forwarded verbatim, not validated.

format.description: Pixel format of the packed page. Forwarded verbatim, not validated.

max_width.description: Maximum width of a packed page, in pixels.

max_height.description: Maximum height of a packed page, in pixels.

combine_subdirectories.description: Combine images from subdirectories of `source_dir` into the parent atlas.

flatten_paths.description: Use only the image filename, discarding its subdirectory path, as the packed region name.

use_indexes.description: Use `_<index>` filename suffixes to indicate animation frame indices.

bleed.description: Bleed transparent pixel colors into the padding to avoid dark edges from filtering.

scale_resampling.description: Resampling filter used when downscaling for a variant's factor. Forwarded verbatim, not validated.

atlas.description: One atlas to pack. Its table key is the atlas name, used as the output filename stem. Alongside `source_dir`/`target_dir`/`variants`, every libGDX TexturePacker setting is accepted here and forwarded verbatim to the packer; any key left out falls back to the root's value, then to its own default. A variant may override any of them for its own pass. `scale`/`scaleSuffix` (driven by variants), `outputFormat`/`jpegQuality` (pages are PNG end to end), `atlasExtension`/`legacyOutput`/`prettyPrint` (the `.atlas` parser reads the legacy format) and `ignore` are not exposed, because pano's pipeline depends on them.

source_dir.description: Source image directory for this atlas. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory.

target_dir.description: Output root for this atlas. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory.

variants.description: Named scale passes. Absent/empty means pack once at factor 1.0, writing directly into `target_dir`. Otherwise each variant writes to `<target_dir>/<variant name>/`.
